cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: The Ledger is waiting on the desk, in a hand that is not yours. The last Keeper wrote until the last watch. The last line is unfinished.

text_variants.text: The Ledger is waiting on the desk, water-stained. The last Keeper wrote about the gauge until the water came for the house.
The Ledger is waiting on the desk. Someone left it there after the last Keeper was walked to the stone. The town, then, still respects the book.

left.label: Read it through
left.outcome: You know what they knew. It is not nothing.

right.label: Start a fresh page
right.outcome: Their hand stays under yours, page after page.

cards.notes: Forced as the second card of run 2+.

cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: Three Keepers in the chair since Dray. The town has stopped learning names. At the inn they call you 'the new one', and the one before you 'the other one'.

left.label: Earn the name
left.outcome: It will take a while. It always does.

cards.speaker: ilse
cards.text: The one before you. I remember one thing about them, and it isn't the thing they'd choose. That's how the town works. What will yours be?

text_variants.text: The one before you stood with the boat people at their remembering. Town didn't like it. Town remembers it anyway. What will yours be?
The one before you signed the paper that cleared the Reach. Quieter now. Some of us liked it. I am not telling you which. What will yours be?

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You have asked about the reservoirs. Noted. The last one asked that too, and the one before. You will find the answer is the same. You will also find I am tired of giving it.

left.label: Then give a different one
left.outcome: "For the record: no." But she stays a moment longer.

cards.speaker: bram
cards.text: A Keeper of this chair once stood with us at the remembering. We do not forget a chair. There is a smoked pike on your sill. It is not a bribe. We do not do those.

right.label: Return it with thanks
right.outcome: "We hold the thanks. Keep the fish."

cards.speaker: quenn
cards.text: I've decided something. Sorry. The last Keeper kept me out of trouble and I let them. This time I'm going to say the figures out loud, to whoever asks. Will you ask?

left.label: Ask
left.outcome: "The aqueduct can't do it. It never could. Roughly."

cards.speaker: src_ledger
cards.text: Tucked in the Ledger: pages of a cipher, half worked, in two different hands. Somebody before you got this far with Dray's book and no further.

left.label: Pick up where they stopped
left.outcome: The gauge marks. It has to be the gauge marks.

right.label: Give the pages to Mirren
right.outcome: She takes them without a word and does not come to the paddles till noon.

cards.speaker: bram
cards.text: You know where the water comes from. So do we, now, in words. If the sluice is opened the river goes home and this pound becomes a road. We ask a gate one thing: will you open it?

left.label: I will open it
left.outcome: "Then we will hold the night for you."

cards.speaker: crane
cards.text: I have read your evidence. I note three conditions for my seal under Schedule Nine: the engineer signs, the newspaper prints the same day on both shores, and nothing is altered. Nothing.

left.label: Agreed, all three
left.outcome: "Duly. I will need a night to draft it properly."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You know. I have known since I was your age. Marrow died building a sluice that would have shared the water. It can be finished, quietly, with Hale's letters and a boatwright who does not talk. It stays a secret. Ours.

left.label: Ours, then
left.outcome: "Noted. I have wanted to say that for a long time."

right.label: Not that way
right.outcome: "Then you will find I have to stop you. For the record, I am sorry."
